title: Quick Charred Kenyan Cheese Casserole
description: A lacto-vegetarian friendly Kenyan dish featuring chilli powder and lardons-render, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This monsoon Kenyan dish is charred to perfection with a cheese-pull.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the macaroni according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a pan, heat the oil and saute the chopped onion until translucent.
Add the lardons to the pan and cook until crispy.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked macaroni, tomato sauce, chilli powder, salt, and black pepper.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, arrange half of the macaroni mixture.
Top with half of the shredded cheese and half of the crispy lardons.
Repeat the layers and top with the remaining cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25 minutes or until the top is charred and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let it rest for a few minutes before serving.
